theory Demo
  imports Main
begin
(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
datatype shape = Circle nat | Rect nat nat
fun area :: "shape ⇒ nat" where
  "area (Circle r) = 3 * r * r"
| "area (Rect w h) = w * h"
lemma area_pos: "area s ≥ 0"
  by (cases s) auto
end
